content.text: Cinematic 16:9 shot: a bright, minimal Scandinavian home office in soft late-afternoon window light. A white desk with a matte-black laptop open, its screen a plain light-grey glow, a small green plant beside it. Slow, smooth dolly-in toward the laptop, shallow depth of field, gentle dust particles in the light. Clean, premium tech-commercial look. No text, no logos, no UI on the screen. Quiet room tone only.
